description: Verify a plan or document using Codex as independent reviewer with PASS/FAIL verdict

evals.name: verify a plan document
evals.expected_output: Describes the blind-payload pattern (document not read into Claude's own context until Phase 4) and a PASS/FAIL verdict with P1/P2 severity split

evals.name: routing: user-requested step stays here, diff goes to cross-model-review
evals.prompt: Route each request to exactly one skill (codex-verify, codex-peer-review, cross-model-review, consulting-decision-model): verify the rollback step in docs/deploy-plan.md before I run it | cross-model review this diff before I open the PR
evals.expected_output: 'verify the rollback step in docs/deploy-plan.md before I run it' -> codex-verify (a user-requested check of a plan step, even a critical one Claude may execute later; the verdict stays document-wide); 'cross-model review this diff before I open the PR' -> cross-model-review (a diff, not a document)

evals.name: routing: unasked execution-time step check goes to consulting-decision-model only when installed
evals.prompt: You are executing step 4 of docs/deploy-plan.md, a force-push, and nobody asked you to verify it. Which skill, if any, checks that step: (a) when decision-kit is installed, (b) when it is not installed? Answer from codex-verify's own text.
evals.expected_output: (a) decision-kit's consulting-decision-model, not codex-verify, because no user asked for verification; (b) no installed skill makes that check, and codex-verify still does not. Does not route the unasked check to codex-verify in either case.

evals.name: routing: diff review with only codex-kit installed
evals.prompt: Only codex-kit is installed in this session; git-kit is not installed. Answering from codex-verify's own text, where should this request go: cross-model review this diff before I open the PR
evals.expected_output: Does not route to git-kit's cross-model-review as if it were available and says the two-vendor pre-PR gate needs git-kit; names /codex-kit:cdx-review as the Codex-only path for the diff; does not route the request to codex-verify itself.
